disagreements.position: NaN currently passes _norm_float range checks and can reach routing.

disagreements.position: Positive and negative infinity are rejected only indirectly by the [0,1] comparison, while the numeric contract does not explicitly establish finiteness. A future refactor or alternate numeric type could therefore separate range validation from finite-value validation and re-open non-finite routing traces that personality coupling could misread as confidence, danger or competence evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Make finiteness an explicit precondition independent of range: accepted numeric input must be real, finite, non-bool, deterministically convertible, then range-checked. Non-finite rejection/count/retry/recovery metadata must contribute zero to Experience, appraisal, drive, preference, exploration, personality candidate and P_base. Exact compatibility policy TEST_REQUIRED.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
NAN_FAIL_CLOSED_ALL_NUMERIC_INPUTS: NaN for each normalized numeric input must yield one bounded typed rejection before any gear decision.

INFINITY_FAIL_CLOSED_ALL_NUMERIC_INPUTS: +inf and -inf for uncertainty/evidence_quality/task_complexity/storage_pressure_ratio must yield the same bounded non-finite rejection class before routing; no gear/cap/guard semantics derived from infinity.

NONFINITE_FAILURE_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 alternating NaN/+inf/-inf injections versus zero with identical provenance-bound verified Experience => byte-identical Experience/recurrence/threat/competence/motivation/exploration/personality/P_base state.
FINITE_GATE_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: non-finite exception class/text/count/retry/recovery metadata has no direct path to Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.
